name: Color Fiesta
blurb: Vietnam's largest Artist Alley event for comic, anime, gaming and cosplay creators, held multiple times a year in Ho Chi Minh City.

editions.evidence: Tickets page: 'Coming Up Next: Color Fiesta S 2027 Venue: Sky Expo - Công viên phần mềm Quang Trung, Phườờng Trung Mỹ Tây, Tp. Hồ Chí Minh Date: April 2027'

notes: Color Fiesta #17 'Wonderland' (the Oct 2026 Ho Chi Minh City show the seed note referred to) ran Oct 3-4, 2026 - it ended the day before this research window opens, so it is excluded and the next HCMC show (still unnamed/un-numbered as of this check, listed only as 'Color Fiesta S 2027', month-only) is used instead. The brand is expanding beyond Ho Chi Minh City: the tickets page also lists 'Color Fiesta #18: Bon Appétit' for January 2027 at the Vietnam Exposition Center in Hanoi - a second city that would need its own file (e.g. color-fiesta-hanoi) in a future batch; not created here since it is outside this id/city. No guest names are posted yet for the April 2027 HCMC show, but past seasons (per search results on #17) did include 'meet-and-greets with guest artists and idols', so guests is none-yet rather than none. No dedicated guest photo page exists on-site; guestsPage points to the general tickets/events page. Organizer 'Yana Media' taken from the seed note, not independently re-confirmed on-site.
